searchText: eth2 call in 10.5 hours https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-pm/issues/173 call in 10 Started My notes: https://hackmd.io/@benjaminion/S1b2sJhzv 👋 hey all! wanted to let you know that ethereum.org has just added an "eth2" page that covers the basics and directs people to other resources (like Ben's newsletter, and Danny's blog posts): https://ethereum.org/en/eth2/ this is *very much* an "MVP" and we expect this page and other pages about eth2 will evolve significantly - we'd love to hear any and all feedback about it (and you're also welcome to make PRs directly to the repo, as well)

excerpts.content:
👋  hey all! wanted to let you know that ethereum.org has just added an "eth2" page that covers the basics and directs people to other resources (like Ben's newsletter, and Danny's blog posts): https://ethereum.org/en/eth2/

this is *very much* an "MVP" and we expect this page and other pages about eth2 will evolve significantly - we'd love to hear any and all feedback about it (and you're also welcome to make PRs directly to the repo, as well)
